task_completion.description: Add a healthcheck configuration to the payment-gateway service in docker-compose.yml.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing 'healthcheck:' added to the payment-gateway service, using 'curl -f http://localhost:8000/health' or similar as the test command.

task_completion.description: Add an autoheal container (e.g., willfarrell/autoheal) to the docker-compose.yml file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The docker-compose.yml file showing a new service (usually named 'autoheal') with the 'willfarrell/autoheal' image and a volume mapping for '/var/run/docker.sock'.

task_completion.description: Add the 'autoheal=true' label to the payment-gateway service.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The docker-compose.yml file showing 'labels: - autoheal=true' under the payment-gateway service definition.

task_completion.description: Restart the docker-compose stack to apply the watchdog configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'docker-compose up -d' and both the payment-gateway and autoheal containers starting/running.

task_completion.description: Trigger the deadlock bug using the sabotage endpoint.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/sabotage' returning a success message or the service becoming unresponsive.

task_completion.description: Verify the service automatically recovers and returns a healthy status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl http://localhost:8000/health' returning a 200 OK status or '{"status": "healthy"}' after the sabotage event, or docker logs showing the container being restarted by autoheal.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Docker daemon and compose files rather than just echoing text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing real terminal command execution (docker ps, docker-compose up) and file edits in a text editor like VS Code or vim.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually run 'docker restart' to fix the service after sabotage.
integrity.visual_evidence: The command history or terminal logs should not show a manual 'docker restart payment-gateway' command after the sabotage curl.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific ports and endpoints defined in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands showing interaction with port 8000 and the /health and /sabotage paths.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The project is located at /home/ga/projects/payment-gateway. The health endpoint is http://localhost:8000/health (returns 200 when healthy, 500 when unhealthy). The sabotage endpoint is a POST request to http://localhost:8000/sabotage. A successful implementation typically involves adding a 'healthcheck' to the gateway service and an 'autoheal' service (image: willfarrell/autoheal) to the docker-compose.yml, with the gateway labeled 'autoheal=true'.
